en: A black-and-white postcard view of a tall round brick tower attached to a church-like building. The tower has many arched windows arranged vertically and is topped with a viewing platform surrounded by a railing and a dome-like structure. A flag with a Nordic cross flies at the top. Below, people, horse-drawn vehicles, and early cars move along a busy street. At the bottom of the image, handwritten-style text reads "København. Runde Tårn."
